name: pdf-data-extractor-bank-statements
title: PDF Data Extractor: Invoices, Receipts, W-9 & Bank Statement Analyzer
description: Extract structured data from digital PDF invoices, receipts, purchase orders, W-9s and bank statements, with no templates. Bank-statement mode returns every transaction, a pass/fail reconciliation, true revenue, a 75+ category taxonomy, MCA positions with missed and bounced payments, and tamper flags. Scanned PDFs are not supported and are not charged.
